name: Break and Steal an Egg Beginner Guide
description: Learn the core gameplay loop before attempting harder runs. Follow the first egg from breaking and hatching to a successful delivery at your base.

highlights.detail: Use your pickaxe to break an egg and hatch an animal.
Take the animal and escape the guards.
Place the animal at your base to earn cash.
Improve your speed and pickaxe, then continue collecting.

name: Break and Steal an Egg Codes and Free Rewards
description: Check code claims against developer announcements before trying them. The official listing advertises like-and-group rewards but does not publish a redeem code or specify its reward.

highlights.label: Group Rewards
highlights.detail: The official description invites players to like the game and join its group for free rewards.

highlights.label: Developer Community
highlights.detail: ILGames x Eggs is the developer community linked from the official game page.

name: Break and Steal an Egg Pickaxe Upgrades
description: Understand the pickaxe's role in opening eggs. Use this guide when deciding whether breaking speed should be your next upgrade priority.

highlights.label: Egg Breaking
highlights.detail: The pickaxe is the tool used to break eggs.

highlights.label: Pickaxe Progression
highlights.detail: Pickaxe upgrades are explicitly included in the official gameplay description.

name: Break and Steal an Egg Speed Guide
description: Learn how movement progression connects to animal delivery. Compare your travel and escape difficulties before deciding what to improve next.

highlights.label: Speed Progression
highlights.detail: Improving speed is one of the progression goals named by the developer.

highlights.label: Escape Objective
highlights.detail: Escaping guards is part of bringing animals back from an egg run.

name: Break and Steal an Egg Eggs and Hatching
description: Understand what happens when you break an egg and hatch an animal. Plan collection attempts around completing the delivery rather than stopping at the hatch.

highlights.detail: Break an egg to hatch an animal.
Take the hatched animal past the guards.
Bring the animal to your base and place it there.

name: Break and Steal an Egg Guards and Escape Guide
description: Focus on the return journey after collecting an animal. Use the guide to practice deliveries without assuming undocumented guard timings or guaranteed safe routes.

highlights.label: Guards
highlights.detail: The developer identifies guards as an obstacle players must escape.

highlights.label: Delivery Goal
highlights.detail: Animals must reach the player's base for placement and cash generation.

name: Break and Steal an Egg Money and Base Guide
description: Understand how collected animals support your base economy. Use successful deliveries as the starting point for planning further progression.

highlights.label: Base Income
highlights.detail: Animals placed at your base earn cash.

highlights.label: Progression Goals
highlights.detail: The official gameplay loop connects base earnings with speed and pickaxe progression.

name: Break and Steal an Egg Animals and Index
description: Turn animal collecting into a clear next objective. Use the in-game Index to organize collection goals rather than relying on unsupported animal rankings.

highlights.label: Animal Collection
highlights.detail: Breaking eggs can hatch rare animals.

highlights.label: Index
highlights.detail: The official description challenges players to collect animals in the Index.
